datasets.name: dq_freshness
queryLines:
SELECT
  'gold_customer_enriched' AS table_name,
  MAX(created_date) AS latest_date,
  DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), MAX(created_date)) AS days_since_update,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM
  sales_datalakehouse.gold.gold_customer_enriched
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'gold_sales_denormalized' AS table_name,
  MAX(product_start_date) AS latest_date,
  DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), MAX(product_start_date)) AS days_since_update,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM
  sales_datalakehouse.gold.gold_sales_denormalized

datasets.name: dq_thresholds
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Completeness' AS dimension,
  'Customer: birth_date NULLs' AS check_name,
  CAST(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN birth_date IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS INT
  ) AS actual_value,
  500 AS warn_threshold,
  1000 AS fail_threshold,
  'NULL count' AS metric_unit,
  CASE
    WHEN
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN birth_date IS NULL THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) > 1000
    THEN
      'FAIL'
    WHEN
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN birth_date IS NULL THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) > 500
    THEN
      'WARN'
    ELSE 'PASS'
  END AS status
FROM
  sales_datalakehouse.gold.gold_customer_enriched
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Completeness',
  'Product: category NULLs',
  CAST(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN category IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS INT
  ),
  5,
  10,
  'NULL count',
  CASE
    WHEN
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN category IS NULL THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) > 10
    THEN
      'FAIL'
    WHEN
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN category IS NULL THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) > 5
    THEN
      'WARN'
    ELSE 'PASS'
  END
FROM
  sales_datalakehouse.gold.gold_sales_denormalized
UNION ALL

## Alert Summary

**FAIL — Action Required (3):**
- Customer `birth_date`: 7,442 NULLs (40.3%)
- Customer data 246 days stale
- Product data 4,839 days stale

**WARN — Monitor (6):**
- Product `category`/`subcategory`/`maintenance`: 7 NULLs each
- Customer `country` Unknown: 337 (1.8%)
- Customer `gender` Unknown: 107 (0.6%)
- Product `cost`: 2 non-positive values

**PASS (2):**
- Product `product_end_date`: 197 NULLs (expected)
- Customer `marital_status`: 0 Unknowns

**Threshold Rules:**
- Completeness: WARN at 5-500, FAIL at 10-1000+
- Correctness: WARN at 50-200, FAIL at 200-500+
- Freshness: WARN at 30-365 days, FAIL at 90-1000+
